title: Solo dev here: my first game Neon Swarm is out on Android (survivor roguelike, no energy)
author: EkmekGurmesi
selftext:
Hi everyone,



I'm a solo developer, and Neon Swarm is the first game I've ever released. It came out on Google Play this week.



It's a portrait survivor roguelike: you steer a mech through an alien hive, your weapons fire on their own, and each level-up lets you pick a weapon or module from three cards. 15 weapons with evolved forms, fusions, 6 pilots, 8 maps and bosses. No energy system, and ads are optional rewarded ads only, never during a run.



Google Play: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gentleaps.neonswarm](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gentleaps.neonswarm)



I'd love to hear what you think: what felt good, what was confusing, how it runs on your phone. If you enjoy it, an honest review would help a small first game a lot. Thanks!
